title: When Can You Trust Offline Evaluation of Equal-Cost Top-k Allocation? A Controlled, Reproducible Benchmark and Practitioner's Guide
abstract: arXiv:2608.12489v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organizations decide whom to treat under a budget and want to know what a targeting rule would have earned before deploying it. Off-policy evaluation promises this from logged data, but the deployable rule is a deterministic top-k policy: it removes all averaging over actions, so weak overlap hits the estimate directly. We benchmark six estimators across five datasets and two known-effect sweeps, and validate the mechanisms against a non-simulated paired reference. First, weak overlap is governed by logger-target action alignment, not by logging sharpness alone: what governs support is the logger's probability of the target's actions. Sharpening a logger built from the target's own score barely moves overlap over the tested range; action-level disagreement collapses it. Effective sample size ranks this risk across logging environments, but is weak at ranking candidates within the single log a practitioner holds, and its cut point does no

translated_title: 何时可以信任等成本Top-k分配的离线评估？一项受控、可复现的基准测试与实践者指南
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12489v1 公告类型：新 摘要：组织在预算限制下决定对谁进行干预，并希望在部署前了解目标规则本应获得的收益。离线策略评估承诺可以从记录的数据中实现这一点，但可部署的规则是确定性的top-k策略：它消除了所有对动作的平均化，因此弱重叠直接冲击估计。我们在五个数据集和两次已知效应扫描上对六种估计器进行了基准测试，并针对非模拟的配对参考验证了机制。首先，弱重叠由记录器与目标动作的对齐程度决定，而不仅仅是记录锐度：决定支持的是记录器对目标动作的概率。由目标自身分数构建的记录器在测试范围内锐化几乎不改变重叠；动作层面的分歧则使其崩溃。有效样本量能在不同记录环境中排序此风险，但在实践者持有的单一日志中对候选者的排序能力较弱，其截止点也不起作用。
tldr: 离线评估top-k策略时，弱重叠风险主要取决于记录器与目标动作的对齐程度，而非记录锐度，且有效样本量对单一日志内候选排序不可靠。
en_tdlr: In offline evaluation of top-k policies, weak overlap risk is governed by logger-target action alignment rather than logging sharpness, and effective sample size is unreliable for ranking candidates within a single log.
